title: Small Gradient Norm Regret for Online Convex Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2601.13519v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper introduces a new problem-dependent regret measure for online convex optimization with smooth losses. The notion, which we call the $G^\star$ regret, depends on the cumulative squared gradient norm evaluated at the decision in hindsight. We show that the $G^\star$ regret strictly refines the existing $L^\star$ (small loss) regret, and that it can be arbitrarily sharper when the losses have vanishing curvature around the hindsight decision. We establish upper and lower bounds on the $G^\star$ regret and extend our results to dynamic regret and bandit settings. As a byproduct, we refine the existing convergence analysis of stochastic optimization algorithms in the interpolation regime. Some experiments validate our theoretical findings.

translated_title: 在线凸优化中的小梯度范数遗憾
translated_abstract: 本文针对具有光滑损失的在线凸优化问题，引入了一种新的问题依赖型遗憾度量。我们将这一概念称为 $G^\star$ 遗憾，它取决于在后见之明决策处评估的累积平方梯度范数。我们证明 $G^\star$ 遗憾严格地细化了现有的 $L^\star$（小损失）遗憾，并且当损失在后见之明决策附近的曲率趋于零时，它可以任意地更加精确。我们建立了 $G^\star$ 遗憾的上界和下界，并将结果扩展到动态遗憾和老虎机设置。作为副产品，我们改进了插值情形下随机优化算法的现有收敛性分析。一些实验验证了我们的理论发现。
tldr: 本文提出了基于后见之明决策处累积平方梯度范数的新遗憾度量 $G^\star$ 遗憾，它严格细化了小损失遗憾并在曲率消失时可任意更紧，同时给出了上下界并扩展至动态遗憾和老虎机设置。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the $G^\star$ regret, a new problem-dependent regret measure based on the cumulative squared gradient norm at the hindsight decision, which strictly refines the small-loss regret and can be arbitrarily tighter when curvature vanishes, with upper and lower bounds extended to dynamic regret and bandit settings.
